about: Melty test checks (recipe test.checks): each is written to Melty's test log once the run proves it, with no one playing. symbol = where it is marked.

rows.proves: the hidden ROUNDS started, loaded its cards and linked to VS
the Vampire Rounds adventure is in VS's adventure data
a run as Orange started on the adventure's stage
ROUNDS's picture of Orange is drawn over VS's stage
ROUNDS's gun fired at VS enemies
a ROUNDS bullet hit and damaged a VS enemy
a VS level-up opened ROUNDS's card pick and a card was taken
a picked ROUNDS card shows as its card-bar square in VS's item area
ROUNDS's block went up in a run (the test player blocks when an enemy closes in), so block cards are exercised
